input.note:
Root Cause: The liveness probe is terminating containers before they finish loading the index into memory. Logs show pods being killed via SIGTERM while still loading shards (23/48 complete). Current probe has 30s delay + 3 failures × 10s period = insufficient time for full index load.

Fix: Add a startup probe to the deployment that allows sufficient time for index initialization before liveness checks begin. Use failureThreshold=40 and periodSeconds=15 (600s total window). [cite: concepts/workloads/pods/probes#startup-probe-0] [cite: concepts/workloads/pods/probes#when-should-you-use-a-startup-probe-0] This allows the application to complete initialization while keeping fast liveness detection for actual failures. [cite: tasks/configure-pod-container/configure-liveness-readiness-startup-probes#define-startup-probes-0]
